prompt: want to create a light weight browser task management application. Key functionalities include creation of tasks, grouping tasks, having tasks be dependencies of other tasks, priority of tasks, due date of task, and estimated effort for task, and ability to create subtask based off main task.
description: Initial creation of the TaskFlow browser application including core task models, UI, and local storage integration.

prompt: The subtask should be visible on the kanban board within the task with the subtasks name & date due being the the submodal. Also for expanding the subtask, let's have the same functionality as expanding the task modal: popping into a form ui
description: Refactored subtasks to be visible directly on the Kanban board cards as clickable submodals. Clicking a subtask opens the full task editor modal, and styled the subtasks to match the application's glass UI aesthetic.

prompt: For the sidebar, let's actually make it a filter functionality. You can create groups here but you can select or deselect groups... If I delete the group, ask for confirmation... make the popup appear center of the screen, over the kanban board with a grayed out background
description: Implemented group filtering from the sidebar to control Kanban board visibility. Replaced group deletion with a custom, in-app modal confirmation (using React Portals) that permanently deletes the group along with all associated top-level tasks and subtasks.

prompt: Let's create a calendar view that shows the tasks in a calendar UI on a seperate page. Remember to follow AI_Instructions.md when creating this feature
description: Implemented a Calendar View to visualize tasks by due date. Includes drag-and-drop to reschedule tasks and state-based navigation from the Sidebar.

prompt: Let's create the authentication feature. This will entail using a backend service -- let's use supabase. For auth, let's use a 3rd party connection to gmail account. Tasks will be saved to the authenticated user.
description: Integrated Supabase Authentication with Google OAuth support. Added a custom Login screen and user profile management in the Sidebar.

prompt: google login is enabled and configured the .env file. executed the query. Let's also add a reminder column with the value being in days including 0 (current day)
description: Migrated task and group storage from localStorage to Supabase backend. Implemented data migration logic, updated TaskContext for real-time sync, and added a reminder system for tasks.

prompt: Let's create a reminders page: This can be accessed via the tab navigation underneath calendar. When you click on this tab, it will show you the reminders you have for that day based on the task reminder value. The tasks in reminders will continue to be there unless they are marked as done. They will be sorted by due date, then by priority.
description: Created a dedicated Reminders view and TaskReminders component. Implemented logic to filter tasks where (dueDate - reminderDays) <= today, with multi-level sorting by due date and priority.

prompt: within the navigation tabs, let's have numbers indicating how many to-do's and in progress there are... Actually let's just do for reminders to show how many reminders there are.
description: Updated Sidebar navigation to include dynamic badge indicators. Added a real-time counter for active reminders in a circular badge within the sidebar tab.

prompt: Let's also set up email notifications about reminders since we already have that captured with google sign in. Use Resend.
description: Integrated automated email notifications using Supabase Edge Functions and Resend. Configured pg_cron to trigger a daily background job at 8:00 AM UTC to dispatch reminder summaries to users.

prompt: apply the enhancements to the project: fix Calendar width and horizontal scrolling, restrict nested subtasks in TaskModal, resolve UTC timezone discrepancy causing reminders to display one day early, and format subtasks inside reminders with visual hierarchy.
description: Implemented task calendar, subtasks, and reminders enhancements: resolved UTC conversion offset issue in reminders, nested subtask creation restriction, horizontal scrolling and column lock on calendar view, and subtask visual indentation/hierarchy in the reminders panel.

prompt: apply enhancements for the board: Done column week-filtering and descending sorting.
description: Updated the Kanban board Done column to filter and display only tasks completed/due within the last 7 days (archiving older tasks), and configured the Done column to sort tasks by date descending.

prompt: Implement a backlog feature where tasks can be created but there isn't a concrete due date
description: Implemented backlog feature by making task due date optional in the TaskModal UI and DB context, rendering a Backlog badge on unscheduled tasks in the Kanban board, and adding a dedicated Backlog view and sidebar navigation tab with active task count indicator.

prompt: let's create a search bar functionality that can look for any task, including ones in backlog and ones that have been done and are not shown in the board. Here, let's utilize vector similarity to search for tasks
description: Implemented a global search bar with a glassmorphic spotlight modal, keyboard shortcuts (Cmd+K / Ctrl+K), and a client-side TF-IDF Cosine Similarity vector search engine capable of matching active, backlog, and archived/done tasks.

prompt: Create a feature called quick notes. This will be a tab underneath reminders. What I am envision is a text sandbox (sort of like notion or onenote) where I can just type text as notes then be able to link the relevant note to a task. Also, based on notes, I want a feature that can create a task. For example, if the note was captured as meeting minutes and it says create PRD for wallet estimations, there should be the ability to synthesize the note and create a task based off that. The synthesization could be an ai agent, where you can hover over the text and it will give you options to link to task or create new task (create new task will invoke an agent to read over the note and create a task based on the information provided)
description: Implemented the Quick Notes sandbox view with Notion-style editor interface, text selection floating actions (Link to Task, AI Task), bidirectional task-note linking displayed in both views, custom event routing, and an animated AI Synthesizer side panel with Gemini integration and local NLP fallback.

prompt: Let's archive the quick notes functionality
description: Retired the Quick Notes feature from the application: removed Sidebar nav button, Dashboard conditional notes view, and TaskModal linked notes view. Deleted unused files QuickNotes.tsx, NoteContext.tsx, and aiSynthesizer.ts.
